headlines.text: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures edge higher as Wall Street awaits the September CPI inflation report
September CPI due at 8:30am ET, with economists forecasting inflation accelerated to around 3.6% annually on higher energy costs
Goldman Sachs crushes Q3 estimates with $5.29 billion in profit as trading revenue surges 23%
Bank of America reports third-quarter results Wednesday, rounding out a mixed start to big bank earnings season
Treasury yields hold near 24-year highs around 5.25% on the 10-year, keeping pressure on stocks
Chip stocks extend their slide as China competition and valuation worries weigh on the Nasdaq
Oil climbs again with Brent crude above $106 and WTI near $95 a barrel ahead of the inflation data
